calls.head: The Oilers can’t afford to cough it up
calls.body: The Ducks turn stolen pucks into chances, and the Oilers are one of the league’s worst at avoiding breakdowns. A sloppy pass or two could cost the Oilers.
calls.call: The Ducks get at least their usual 7.7% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
calls.nums: Anaheim 4th for chances off turnovers (7.7% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Edmonton 29th for avoiding breakdowns
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: 0.4% of Anaheim’s 5-on-5 chances came right after winning the puck, against their usual 7.7%.

calls.head: Quality over quantity for the Oilers
calls.body: The Ducks have struggled to prevent dangerous shots, and the Oilers don’t waste many.
calls.call: The Oilers’ average shot has at least their usual 6.5% chance of going in.
calls.nums: Edmonton 10th for shot quality (a 6.5% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Anaheim 25th for preventing dangerous shots
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: Edmonton’s average shot had a 7.5% chance of going in, against their usual 6.5%.

ANA.head: We had this close to even (45% for Anaheim), and it went Edmonton’s way.

EDM.head: We had this close to even (55% for Edmonton), and Edmonton came through.

surprises.head: Anaheim brought the hits
surprises.body: Anaheim’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 169, against their usual 105 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 30 games.

surprises.head: A rough night for L. Dostal
surprises.body: L. Dostal allowed 5 goals on shots worth 2.1 expected goals, 2.9 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 25 starts over the last three seasons.

story.head: The Oilers come back from two down
paras: Beckett Sennecke opened the scoring early in the first. Evan Bouchard added two goals. Four different Oilers scored. The Ducks led by two, but the Oilers came all the way back. Anaheim pulled Lukas Dostal after five goals.

The score flatters the Oilers: the Ducks had the better of the play. Replay the chances a hundred times and the Ducks win about six in ten. Devon Levi made the difference in net, stopping 29 of 31. By our Swing measure, Leon Draisaitl had the best night of anyone.

items.text: Three straight wins for the Oilers.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
